subject: Cognitive Science
title: Pragmatics: Reading Between the Lines
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pragmatics: Reading Between the Lines usable.

hook.text: Someone asks 'Can you pass the salt?' You don't say 'Yes, I can' and sit still. You pass the salt.

buildup.text: Pragmatics is the study of meaning beyond literal words—the intentions, context, and social rules behind speech.

discovery.text: Paul Grice identified maxims of conversation: be relevant, be brief, be truthful, and be clear.

twist.text: We constantly violate these maxims on purpose. Sarcasm, irony, and politeness all work by breaking the rules.

climax.text: An AI that only understands literal meaning would fail at human conversation within seconds.

punchline.text: Most of what we mean is never actually said.
